stem.text: Asthma can affect children and adults. The air passages become narrower, severely restricting the flow of air into the lungs.
Salbutamol is a drug that widens the air passages to relieve the symptoms of asthma.
How does salbutamol relieve the symptoms of asthma?

A.text: It decreases mucus secretions in the terminal bronchioles.

B.text: It decreases the surface area of the alveoli.

C.text: It causes recoil of elastic tissue in the bronchioles.

D.text: It relaxes smooth muscle in the bronchi and bronchioles.
